units.source_text: 我向这双巨掌微微点了点头。

en.t: I gave a slight nod toward those two enormous palms.

units.source_text: 父亲从我小脸的颔首，立即明白我是谅解和同意了。

en.t: From the nod of my small face, Father at once understood that I had accepted and agreed.
Then Father moved his palms away...

units.source_text: 手掌移开以后，我如实地按照手掌的命令，继续坚持闭上眼睛，直到清晨室外令人目眩的阳光透进了我的眼帘。

en.t: After the palms were moved away, I faithfully obeyed their command and kept my eyes closed until the dazzling morning sunlight outside filtered through my eyelids.
I was unable to sleep all through the night until dawn.
